display.intent: Add items to a candy machine
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} adds items (names and links) to candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} from position ${data.index}

${accounts.payer} creates candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} of ${data.data.itemsAvailable} items for collection ${accounts.collectionMint}, symbol ${data.data.symbol}, royalty ${data.data.sellerFeeBasisPoints}, with ${accounts.authority} as authority

${accounts.payer} creates candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} of ${data.data.itemsAvailable} items for collection ${accounts.collectionMint}, symbol ${data.data.symbol}, royalty ${data.data.sellerFeeBasisPoints}, with ${accounts.authority} as authority
${accounts.mintAuthority} mints NFT ${accounts.nftMint} of collection ${accounts.collectionMint} from candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine}, paid by ${accounts.payer}
${accounts.mintAuthority} mints NFT ${accounts.nftMint} of collection ${accounts.collectionMint} from candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} for ${accounts.nftOwner}, paid by ${accounts.payer}
${accounts.authority} hands the authority of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} to ${data.newAuthority}
${accounts.authority} sets the collection of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} to ${accounts.newCollectionMint}
${accounts.authority} sets the collection of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} to ${accounts.newCollectionMint}

display.label: New Mint Authority (takes control of minting)

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} makes ${accounts.mintAuthority} the mint authority of candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine}, the only account that may mint from it
${accounts.authority} sets candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} to mint token standard ${data.tokenStandard}
${accounts.authority} updates candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} to ${data.data.itemsAvailable} items, symbol ${data.data.symbol}, royalty ${data.data.sellerFeeBasisPoints}
${accounts.authority} closes candy machine ${accounts.candyMachine} and takes its rent
